svg.text: Solid box = compute; dashed box = communication (⇄). Top right: wire bytes per rank per row · per layer per block
Wave 1 dtypes as (2), plus the receive side sized from the counts (in-kernel
remote-DMA ragged a2a, a later wave). Not implemented yet
HBM DMA = 94 MiB + E(R) + 235.8 KiB x R = ~1,817 MiB/layer @R=4096 (E=780) + KV
assumes receive buffers sized to rows actually received (~R), not R*8
stream [R/8, H] f32 -> RMS f32 -> a_in [R/8, H] fp8 e4m3
[R/8, H] fp8 e4m3 -> [R, H] fp8 e4m3, scale f32
= 7/8 x H x 1B = 7/8 x 8192 x 1 = 7 KiB (+ 4 B row scale)
a_in fp8 e4m3 @ wqkvg fp8 e4m3 -> f32 acc
head-RMS f32 -> q fp8 e4m3 (RPA q_scale); K/V fp8 e4m3
P fp8 e4m3; QK / PV acc f32
head-RMS(o) f32 -> gated fp8 e4m3 @ wo fp8 e4m3
⇄ o RS (bf16: sum feeds post-attn norm)
post-attn RMS f32; stream [R/8, H] f32
KV read: 244 MiB per 1M attended tokens (fp8 pool, required)
HBM DMA: weights 26 MiB + act 70.25 KiB x R
RMS f32 -> ffn [R/8, H] fp8 e4m3
router input / logits: bf16 / f32 until GSM8K A/B
ffn fp8 e4m3 @ wpool [H, He] fp8 e4m3 -> f32 acc
RMS f32 -> xe [R/8, He] fp8 e4m3 + f32 scale
HBM DMA: weights 36 MiB + act 3 KiB x R
= 2 AG x 7 peers x 8 x 4B = 448 B per layer, not per row
xe[pairs] [R/8*8, He] fp8 e4m3 -> recv [R*8, He]
local expert ids int32 + row scales f32
= 1/8 own rows x 8 slots x He x 1B x 7/8
xe fp8 e4m3 x NVFP4 e2m1 / fp8 e4m3 weights
h = silu(g)*u -> fp8 e4m3 into w2; acc f32
y [R*8, He] bf16 -> owner [R/8*8, He] bf16
= 1/8 own rows x 8 slots x He x 2B x 7/8
post-expert RMS f32; x tw f32, sum k
HBM DMA: weights E(R) = 780 MiB + act 150 KiB x R
u fp8 e4m3 @ wunpool [He, H] fp8 e4m3 -> f32 acc
HBM DMA: weights 32 MiB + act 12.5 KiB x R
R = rows this step: prefill = chunk tokens (block size 4096); decode = B rounded up to 8
R/8 = rows owned by one rank; n = 8; H = 8192; He = 4096; I = 4096 (512 per rank)
KiB/row = bytes one rank sends to the other 7 per token row (AG: own block x7; RS: 7/8 of partial)
MiB = KiB/row x R / 1024, one layer, one rank
HBM DMA = fixed weights + E(R) experts + per-row KiB x R, per layer per rank (estimate: each HBM
tensor written once, read once); E(R) = 780 MiB x (1 - (31/32)^R), x EP worst-rank imbalance;
tile re-reads and XLA fusion not modeled; fp4 experts at QBLOCK=256 (3.05 MiB per expert-TP slice)
Decode columns (4)-(8) all use R=64 (spec decoding), so their numbers compare directly
decode packs bf16 pairs into u32 words (common/packing.py)
FP8_GATHER only affects the xe / u AG of (1); (2) rejects it
(2) is uncommitted wave 1: it requires MOE_MODE=ep, which serving still rejects
